purpose: Row-resolution dossiers for the residual blockers that remain after the provisional sensitivity pass.

row_dossiers.name: Nb3Sn
row_dossiers.unit_decision_question: Confirm whether the retained phonon proxy for the benchmark row should be Debye temperature (Theta_D_K) or log-phonon frequency (omega_log_K) before touching lambda_ep.
required_row_fields: Tc_K or Tc_exp_K with cited row source
phonon proxy field and unit basis (Theta_D_K or omega_log_K)
mu_star with row citation or declared benchmark convention
row_dossiers.decision_gate: External row resolution required before any normalization decision.
row_dossiers.claim_boundary: This dossier is a row-resolution work packet. It narrows what must be checked next, but it does not certify any material row until an upstream or literature row is attached.
